# Legacy observations: T3 Scale and rotations (local probe, 2026-10-05)

Captured by the `legacy_visual_t3_capture` probe ([`visual_t3_capture.cpp`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/visual_t3_capture.cpp), target in [`tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt)) on the cases in [`inputs/visual-t3-cases.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/inputs/visual-t3-cases.txt). The probe compiles the legacy `HikariSub/VisualScale.cpp`, `VisualRotationZ.cpp`, `VisualRotationXY.cpp` and `Timebase.cpp` at `20d647c4` unchanged and copies these out of their files unchanged ([`extract_functions.py`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/extract_functions.py)): the `Visuals`, `Scale`, `RotationZ` and `RotationXY` classes (Visuals.h), `FindData` and `TagFindReplace` (TagFindReplace.h), `ClipPoint` (VisualClipPoint.h), `AssColor` and `Styles` (styles.h), `TagData` and `ParseData` (SubsDialogue.h); Visuals' constructor, destructor, GetDialoguesWithoutPosition, GetDialogueAdditionalPosition, GetRectFromSize, IsInRect, RenderSubs, both SetVisual, SizeChanged, DrawArrow, DrawRect, Draw, DrawWarning, CalcMovePos, GetVectorPoints, GetMoveTimes, GetPosnScale, GetPosition, ChangeOrg, SetModified, GetTextSize, GetDrawingSize, RotateZ and Curve; TagFindReplace's FindTag, ReplaceAll, Replace, TagValueToStyle, GetDouble, GetTwoValueDouble, ChangeText, GetTextResult, GetPositionInText and FindBrackets; Styles' and AssColor's constructors and number getters, Styles::Copy, AssColor::SetAss and SetAlphaString; TagData, ParseData, Dialogue::ClearParse, ParseTags and GetDefaultPosition; ClipPoint's constructors; CreateVERTEX; getfloat and FindFromEnd. They run against stand-ins ([`tools/legacy-capture/visual_t3/`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/visual_t3)) with the legacy member names: the Dialogue (Text, TextTl, Style, times, margins, GetTextNoCopy/GetText/SetText as SubsDialogue.cpp:216-232), the grid and its file (selections, styles, GetStyle as SubsFile.cpp:818-830, CopyDialogue changing the probe's own Lines), the editors (EditBox::GetEditor and IsCursorOnStart as EditBox.cpp, Send writing the editors into the Line), the video (Tell, the Timebase, GetWindowSize), the Linux D3DX stand-ins of the legacy tree, and a fixed text measure (GetLineTextExtents: a character half the font size wide, the font size high, a descent of a fifth and a leading of a tenth, times ScaleX / ScaleY), which the rewrite's test measures the same way.

Built locally with GCC 16.2.1 and the distribution's wxWidgets 3.2.11 (wxGTK). Run:

```
cmake -S tools/legacy-capture -B <dir> -DLEGACY_SOURCE=<checkout at 20d647c4> -DWX_CONFIG=$(which wx-config)
cmake --build <dir> --target legacy_visual_t3_capture
<dir>/legacy_visual_t3_capture < tools/legacy-capture/inputs/visual-t3-cases.txt > observations.jsonl
```

`observations.jsonl` holds one line per `state` step (81, over 31 cases): every Line's Text and TextTl, the editor's text (TextEdit, TextEditOrig) and selection, the grid's SetModified and EditBox::Send records, the log, the tool's `from`, `to` and `moveValues`, and per tool: Scale's scale, lastScale, originalScale, arrowLengths, type, grabbed, AN, sizing rectangles, originalSize, border and rectangle visibility; RotationZ's org, lastmove, lastAngle, two points, their visibility and mode; RotationXY's org, angle, oldAngle, firstmove, type and AN. sha256 `26f48a5a…679d9`.

The cases (one view with the coefficient 3 unless named; a pillarbox with T1's zoom-pillarbox zoom; T1's zoom-at-point zoom): Scale's width drag (left), height drag (right), both (middle), proportional (Shift), at the editor's caret in a later block and in plain text, "change all scale tags", several Lines, several Lines with "preserve proportions" (positions, a rectangle clip, a vector clip with a scale, an \iclip Bézier, a W/A/S/D nudge after), the nudges (Shift, Alt alone ignored, Ctrl), a \move with 6 and with 4 values, the rectangle (both axes, height only, the rectangle's edge dragged and moved), the custom rectangle drawn with the right button, a TLMode translation, the zoomed pillarbox; RotationZ's drag, the Style's angle, \org on one Line and on several (one without \pos, one with its \org after another tag), stacked unpositioned Lines (GetDialogueAdditionalPosition), the two-point angle (first click, second click, dragging a point, a click elsewhere, a new active Line), "change all", several with "preserve proportions" (clips, a \move), the zoomed \org drag, a \move's position at the video's time; RotationXY's left, right and middle drags with the grid drawn, "change all" and back, several Lines, the \org on one Line and then on two.

## Compared with the rewrite

`VisualCapture.ReplaysTheLegacyT3Probe` (`hikari_application_visual_transform_tests`) builds each case's Document, view (from the frame and zoom, checked against the case's rectangle and zoom), selection and caret, drives `visual::ScaleTool`, `RotationZTool` and `RotationXYTool` with the same pointer and key events, and at every step compares every Line's text and translation, the editor's text on the one-Line path (the gesture's staged text while it runs), the editor's caret (the tool's while a one-Line gesture runs, since the rewrite's editor shows the Document until the release; the editor's otherwise), the SetModified (`history`) and Send (`sent`) records against the history steps the tools make, the log, and the tool's handles exactly. The replay's host resets the tool after a commit as the app does unless the tool keeps its state, which these three do (legacy ran no SetVisual after them). One difference, named in the test: legacy committed on every release (VisualRotationZ.cpp:150-152), so in `rotz-two-points` the release after the first point (step 1) and after a click off both points (step 5) sent the unchanged text, which made an undo step (CopyDialogue marks the file edited); the rewrite opens no gesture there and records no step. No other difference; no departure is used.

The capture shows these legacy behaviours, kept (proposed departures in the T3 report, not applied):

- ChangeOrg (several Lines) moves its end by its start less one before ChangeText, so an \org that is not the block's first tag takes the characters after it: `{\an7\org(10,20)\frz30}Second` became `{\an7\org(40,50)30}Second`, and `{\pos(30,40)\org(100,100)}Other` lost `}Other` (case rotz-zoom-org).
- The \org drag's offset adds the zoom's offset (`((org - lastOrg) / zoomScale + zoomMove) * coeff`), so zoomed it jumps by the zoom's offset (rotz-zoom-org).
- Scale's clip rewrite loses a vector clip's scale (`clip.BeforeFirst(',', &clip)`: `\clip(2,m 0 0 ...)` became `\clip(m -192 -108 ...)`); RotationZ's keeps it and makes a rectangle clip 2 taller.
- The several-Line path writes the active Line's scale into every target (a click without a drag included), and "change all" adds the tag to the first block of a Line that has it only later (both proposed departures in the T3 report).
